title: Read parsed route contracts in an API explorer extension
goal: Inspect discovered route parameters, defaults and policy declarations when building API explorer tooling; preserve optional and catch-all semantics without reparsing displayed URLs.

runtime.name: .NET / ASP.NET Core
runtime.reason: ApiDescription.RoutePattern is present in the ASP.NET Core 11 contract; the measured baseline is RC2, not GA.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build net11.0 against the matching reference pack. Exact tested pins are reproduction baselines, not minimum patches.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Tested mode; this extension uses no C#15-only syntax. The comparison is C#14.

packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App framework reference; ApiDescription is in Mvc.Abstractions, discovery in Mvc.ApiExplorer and parsed types in Routing. No NuGet libraries or native assets restored.
providers: Built-in MVC DefaultApiDescriptionProvider for visible attribute-routed controllers; built-in EndpointMetadataApiDescriptionProvider registered by AddEndpointsApiExplorer for described Minimal API handlers. Other providers may leave RoutePattern null.
platforms: ASP.NET Core supported server platforms; execution evidence covers Windows x64 only
renderingModes: Server HTTP routing and API discovery; no browser or Blazor rendering requirement
prerequisites: Register AddControllers and AddEndpointsApiExplorer, map controllers and Minimal handlers, then obtain IApiDescriptionGroupCollectionProvider after endpoint initialization. Copy every standalone file below, including isolation files and SDK pins.
constraints: Do not reconstruct the new nullable RoutePattern from RelativePath: displayed paths are provider-dependent and MVC loses constraints. Null means unavailable, not a literal route with no parameters.

ParameterPolicies reports declarations or object types; it does not evaluate policies, prove authorization, validate input or guarantee matches. Matching also depends on HTTP methods, binding, other endpoints and application middleware.

The .NET10 comparison reparses MVC attribute templates and bounded provider-dependent Minimal RelativePath; it is not a backport. Arbitrary custom or legacy descriptions can be incomplete or malformed. No older-target parsed-property route is supported.
No OpenAPI document generation/transformer, conventional-controller discovery guarantee, third-party provider, trimming, NativeAOT or deployment claim.
stabilityLimitations: No ExperimentalAttribute on the actual property. Stable API designation with exact RC2 proof; actual-GA reconciliation PIN-964, comprehensive coverage PIN-959 and existing Human gates remain open.

selectionNotes: Consume the nullable parsed property on .NET11. The tested .NET10 template-parsing workaround is comparison-only; no ninth foundation or older-target property backport.
